applies_to: Carrier AquaForce 30XA080-501 air-cooled screw chillers with the BACnet communication option (UPC Open controller).
summary: This 30XA list covers the UPC Open BACnet MS/TP option on 30XA080-501 chillers. It has about 270 AVs and BVs: start/stop, occupancy, emergency stop, control point, demand and current limit, heat/cool select, setpoints, water temperatures, refrigerant pressures, fan and compressor run hours, pumps and alarm state.
default_device_instance: Network number 16101 followed by the MAC address (MAC 20 gives 1610120)
notes: BACnet comes from the optional UPC Open controller, mounted in a separate enclosure below the main control box; object names end in _1.
The Network Points List gives a point description, CCN name, read/write, units, default and range for each object; descriptions here are the printed point descriptions.

This is the UPC Open BACnet MS/TP option for 30XA080-501 with the Carrier Controller display. The separate 30XA BACnet/Modbus translator list (30XA-100T, 30XA140-352 with Touch Pilot) is a different interface with its own, much shorter object list; check which one is fitted.
The table has no CCN name column on these pages.
AV 93 Run Status codes: 0 Off, 1 Running, 2 Stopping, 3 Delay, 4 Tripout, 5 Ready, 6 Override, 7 Defrost, 8 Run Test, 9 Test. AV 137 Alarm State: 0 Normal, 1 Partial, 2 Shutdown.

source.title: AquaForce 30XA080-501 Air-Cooled Liquid Chillers - Controls, Start-Up, Operation, Service and Troubleshooting (Appendix G, BACnet Communication, Network Points List)

integration.summary: Address the UPC Open, set the MS/TP DIP switches, and run the chiller in network (CCN) mode. The BMS writes chiller start/stop and occupancy, control point and demand limit; read run status, leaving fluid temperature, capacity and alarm state.
integration.enable: Press the Start/Stop button on the Carrier Controller display and select CCN Mode on the Equipment Start screen. CHIL_S_S (BV 1) then starts and stops the chiller: forced to Disable the unit stops, forced to Enable it runs per schedule 1.
integration.heartbeat: The manual says that if communication with the network is lost, the machine starts and is controlled locally.
gotchas: The 30XA also has a separate BACnet/Modbus translator option with a different point list.
setup: The BACnet option adds a UPC Open controller; it speaks BACnet MS/TP at 9600, 19.2k, 38.4k or 76.8k (Carrier default 76.8k), set on BAS port DIP switches DS1-DS2.
For MS/TP set DS3 to enable, DS4 to E1-485 and the protocol switches DS5-DS8 to MSTP; the EIA-485 jumpers must be set to EIA-485 and 2W.
MAC address from the two rotary switches (tens and ones); the controller reads switches and DIP settings only at power-up.
Device instance is auto-generated as the network number (default 16101) followed by the MAC address, e.g. MAC 20 gives 1610120; change it with i-Vu Tools or a BACview.
Fit a BT485 terminator on the first and last controller of the MS/TP segment.
